$comment: Butler's Bell (Demonic Pacts tier 4; leaguerelics/ButlersBell.LeagueRelics.js). The jobs are the cache's butlers_bell_actions rows (table 226: action_id, raw_noun, processed_noun, processed_xp, xp_skill, gather_base_rate per minute); a processing job runs at half the rate (Wiki). `gather` and `process` are each job's weighted rolls per item, from the Wiki's drop tables (Butler's_Bell_(Demonic_Pacts_League)#Drops, Jagex's weightings per gather), by ItemIdentifiers name. `lines` are the Wiki transcript's (Transcript:Demon_butler_(Butler's_Bell)), with its [sir/madam/neutral] alternatives; `noInstances` is the bell's (Wiki, Butler's bell (item) trivia). No recording of the bell exists.

lines.newJob: I have a new job for you.
lines.show: Show me what you've collected so far.
lines.collectFirst: [Apologies, sir,/Apologies, madam,/Apologies,] but you will need to collect the resources I have already procured before I commence work on anything new.
lines.processNo: No, just give me the raw materials. <col=3366ff>({rate}/Minute)</col>
lines.nothingYet: I am afraid I have not managed to collect anything new [just yet, sir/just yet, madam/just yet].
lines.useVoice: [Sorry, sir,/Sorry, madam,/Sorry,] but may find it easier to communicate verbally, instead of using the bell.
lines.noInstances: You can't use that inside instances

_ours: Not in any source, so ours: the job menu lists the jobs by the cache's raw_noun in action_id order under the default title; the butler stands beside the player who rang (the random events' tile) and leaves when they log out or he is out of their view; the collection goes to the bank (the Wiki's interface shows thousands of bars, which no inventory holds; what the bank cannot take stays with him) and its XP is shared as it is collected.
